notes: D19-3: the man plays on. Chance per man per match and days out are gameplay estimates (no injury rates for 1888-89 were found); 0 days = fit for the next match. No substitutes existed (the League allowed one for an injured man only in 1965).
D19-3: hurt but stays on as a passenger (no substitutes), worth strengthWhileHurt of a fit man for the rest of the match. Rates and days out are estimates.

D19-3: carried off, the side plays short; with returnChance he comes back on later as a passenger (strengthWhileHurt). Ross McMahon (Bolton) was injured in both his 1888-89 League games. Rates and days out are estimates.
